summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the custom of breaking a glass at the end of a wedding ceremony and what it represents. He reviews the history and practice of reciting verses from Tehillim, avoiding musical performances during this moment, and dealing with the broken glass afterward.
questions: Why do we break a glass at the end of a wedding ceremony?
Which verses from Tehillim does the groom recite before breaking the glass?
What was the custom in Baghdad regarding what is broken?
What should be done with the broken glass according to sources?
Why are musical performances of Im Eshkachech discouraged at this moment?
